title: A picked sound clip draws no size badge or handles on the picture
goal: When a sound clip (music, a tone, a voice) is picked in a video, the picture shows a blue "0 × 0" size badge and a handle at its top left corner, as if the sound were a box with no size. A sound has nothing on the picture, so nothing should be drawn there for it.
notes: Seen 2026-11-13 by the playback-speed runner: Scripts/playtest.sh Scripts/playtest/playback-speed-walk.json drops fixtures/A 440 Hz tone 12s.m4a onto the sample recording; it lands picked, and every window capture after (queue/audits/2026-11-13-picked-sound-shows-0x0-badge.png, top left of the picture at about (400,115) in the 2541-wide view) shows a blue 0 × 0 pill and a handle above the picture. Not chased further.
acceptance: With only a sound clip picked, the canvas shows no size badge, no handles and no outline
A walk picks a sound clip and checks the canvas carries no readout for it, at Next defaults
